affected_system: housing inspection, code enforcement, repair, and tenant-support system
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased proactive inspection and repair-support program
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased proactive inspection and repair-support program
pair staggered building-level evaluation with tenant outcome panels with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Complaints, inspections, violations, ownership, repair, and closure records retain distinct semantics.
Tenant vulnerability and building condition are measured only from authorized, documented sources.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased proactive inspection and repair-support program.

constraints.description: The housing habitability and code operations evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_question: Did phased proactive inspection reduce verified severe conditions without displacement or selective enforcement?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The housing habitability and code operations evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased proactive inspection and repair-support program
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased proactive inspection and repair-support program passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: staggered building-level evaluation with tenant outcome panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in verified severe condition duration

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased proactive inspection and repair-support program, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in verified severe condition duration
distributional gap in change in verified severe condition duration
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal habitability, health, or displacement effects from complaint closure alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased proactive inspection and repair-support program passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate proactive housing inspection and repair support
transportability_risks: Housing law, tenure, building age, complaint access, inspection practice, and enforcement differ.
Complaint records may over- or under-represent physical conditions and retaliation risk.
